name: Fire Up Together
storyline:
Embark on the Fire Up Together Adventure With Your Friends!
Set out from the fire station, connect your hoses to hydrants, and carry your water supply as high as possible. Extinguish the fires in your path, overcome challenging obstacles, and climb as high as you can with your friends!

Play Solo or With Friends
Take on this crazy adventure alone or form a team of up to four players.

Master Physics-Based Hose Mechanics
Your hose is powered by a physics simulation: it wraps around platforms, stretches, and swings. Swing from wherever it gets caught to keep moving, or let a teammate grab onto your hose and climb up. But be careful—a tangled hose will eventually become your problem too.

Rise With the Power of Water
The pressurized water blasting from your fire hose isn’t just for putting out fires. Use its recoil to launch yourself into the air, reach platforms, and climb higher.

Of course, you can also turn your hose on your friends. Teach troublesome teammates a little lesson and enjoy sending them tumbling back down!

The Firefighters’ New Favorite Sport: HoseBall
How about playing a little HoseBall at the fire station before setting off on your adventure?

In this game, you don’t kick the ball—you blast it with pressurized water! Control your hose, line up long-range shots, and send the ball into the goal before your friends do.
summary: Fire Up Together is a physics-based co-op platforming adventure for up to four players. Use pressurized water to launch yourself into the air, extinguish fires, overcome chaotic obstacles, and climb as high as possible with your friends.
